ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Funded') && ISPICKVAL(BofI_Deal__c,'Yes') && (ISPICKVAL(Type,'RENEWAL') || ISPICKVAL(Type,'CONCURRENT') || ISPICKVAL(Type,'CONCURRENT RENEWAL')) && ACTUAL_AMT_OFFERED__c <> SUM_of_BofI_ACH_Payments__c && ISBLANK(Fund_Date__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 'Actual Amount Offered' must be equal to the Sum of BofI ACH Payments
